defmodule CryptoVault.RateLimiter do
  @moduledoc """
  Rate limiter for cryptographic operations using encrypted counters.
  Prevents brute-force attacks on key derivation endpoints.
  """
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_attempts 5
  @window_ms 60_000

  defstruct [:storage, :cipher_state]

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_opts) do
    storage = :ets.new(:rate_limit_store, [:set, :private])
    cipher_state = initialize_cipher()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{storage: storage, cipher_state: cipher_state}}
  end

  @doc "Check if a client_id is rate limited, returns {:ok, remaining} or {:error, :rate_limited}"
  def check_rate(client_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check_rate, client_id})
  end

  @doc "Record an attempt for a client_id"
  def record_attempt(client_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:record_attempt, client_id})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:check_rate, client_id}, _from, state) do
    case get_counter(client_id, state) do
      {:ok, count, timestamp} ->
        if expired?(timestamp) do
          {:reply, {:ok, @max_attempts}, state}
        else
          remaining = @max_attempts - count
          if remaining > 0 do
            {:reply, {:ok, remaining}, state}
          else
            {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
          end
        end
      :not_found ->
        {:reply, {:ok, @max_attempts}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:record_attempt, client_id}, _from, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    case get_counter(client_id, state) do
      {:ok, count, timestamp} ->
        if expired?(timestamp) do
          new_state = put_counter(client_id, 1, now, state)
          {:reply, {:ok, @max_attempts - 1}, new_state}
        else
          new_count = increment_counter(count)
          new_state = put_counter(client_id, new_count, timestamp, state)
          remaining = @max_attempts - new_count
          if remaining > 0 do
            {:reply, {:ok, remaining}, new_state}
          else
            {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, new_state}
          end
        end
      :not_found ->
        new_state = put_counter(client_id, 1, now, state)
        {:reply, {:ok, @max_attempts - 1}, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp get_counter(client_id, state) do
    key_hash = derive_storage_key(client_id)
    case :ets.lookup(state.storage, key_hash) do
      [{^key_hash, encrypted_blob}] ->
        decrypt_counter(encrypted_blob, state.cipher_state)
      [] ->
        :not_found
    end
  end

  defp put_counter(client_id, count, timestamp, state) do
    key_hash = derive_storage_key(client_id)
    encrypted_blob = encrypt_counter(count, timestamp, state.cipher_state)
    :ets.insert(state.storage, {key_hash, encrypted_blob})
    state
  end

  defp increment_counter(count) do
    # Simple increment - counter is bounded by rate limit check
    count + 1
  end

  defp expired?(timestamp) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    (now - timestamp) > @window_ms
  end

  defp initialize_cipher do
    key = load_counter_key()
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
    %{key: key, iv: iv, algorithm: :aes_128_ctr}
  end

  # Load the counter encryption key from runtime configuration / environment
  # instead of hardcoding it in source. Expected to be 16 bytes for AES-128.
  defp load_counter_key do
    key =
      case Application.get_env(:crypto_vault, :counter_key) do
        nil ->
          case System.get_env("CRYPTO_VAULT_COUNTER_KEY") do
            nil ->
              raise "CryptoVault.RateLimiter: counter key is not configured. " <>
                      "Set :counter_key in application config or the " <>
                      "CRYPTO_VAULT_COUNTER_KEY environment variable (base16-encoded, 16 bytes)."

            encoded ->
              decode_key(encoded)
          end

        configured when is_binary(configured) ->
          normalize_key(configured)
      end

    unless byte_size(key) == 16 do
      raise "CryptoVault.RateLimiter: counter key must be exactly 16 bytes for AES-128."
    end

    key
  end

  defp normalize_key(value) when byte_size(value) == 16, do: value
  defp normalize_key(value), do: decode_key(value)

  defp decode_key(encoded) do
    case Base.decode16(encoded, case: :mixed) do
      {:ok, decoded} -> decoded
      :error -> raise "CryptoVault.RateLimiter: counter key must be valid base16."
    end
  end

  defp derive_storage_key(client_id) do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, [<<"rate_limit:">>, to_string(client_id)])
  end

  defp encrypt_counter(count, timestamp, cipher_state) do
    plaintext = <<count::unsigned-integer-size(32), timestamp::signed-integer-size(64)>>
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
    ciphertext = :crypto.crypto_one_time(
      cipher_state.algorithm,
      cipher_state.key,
      iv,
      plaintext,
      true
    )
    <<iv::binary-size(16), ciphertext::binary>>
  end

  defp decrypt_counter(<<iv::binary-size(16), ciphertext::binary>>, cipher_state) do
    plaintext = :crypto.crypto_one_time(
      cipher_state.algorithm,
      cipher_state.key,
      iv,
      ciphertext,
      false
    )
    <<count::unsigned-integer-size(32), timestamp::signed-integer-size(64)>> = plaintext
    {:ok, count, timestamp}
  end
end

defmodule CryptoVault.KeyDerivation do
  @moduledoc "Key derivation service protected by rate limiting."
  require Logger

  def derive_key(client_id, password, salt) do
    case CryptoVault.RateLimiter.record_attempt(client_id) do
      {:ok, _remaining} ->
        key = Plug.Crypto.KeyGenerator.generate(password, salt, iterations: 100_000, length: 32, digest: :sha256)
        {:ok, Base.encode16(key, case: :lower)}
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        Logger.warning("Rate limited client: #{client_id}")
        {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end
end
